target: KBL full-game two-way win market only; handicap and total separate and excluded until product-specific official settlement verified
hypothesis: Officially confirmed predecision absence of a previously active key or foreign player adds predictive information beyond the same-time market and no-fact baseline.
decision: actual decision time no later than scheduled tipoff minus 30 minutes; only actually received inputs at or before decision
fields: event_id and canonical official game and team IDs
scheduled tipoff and actual decision with timezone
player ID and team; foreign-player flag; status before and after with official source bytes and actual receipt timestamps
last 10 prior eligible boxscores with minutes and actual receipt times
both team rest hours and travel locations from prior completed games as actually received
prior possessions per 40 minutes and source receipt
product ID, market, period, full price vector, line, actual observed and received timestamps, settlement terms and bytes
frozen operating selection and revision if present
final result and official actual receipt time and correction history
model: One candidate: logistic market-offset regression with one signed availability feature = away missing prior-10 mean minutes minus home missing prior-10 mean minutes, using officially confirmed absences only. Mean minutes uses completed predecision games with actual receipt evidence; no prior appearances is missing, not zero. L2 penalty 10 fixed; intercept and one coefficient fitted using earlier labels available by fit time. No manual probability adjustment.
eligibility: Require complete real evidence for both sides and full market quote, status and preceding minutes; abstain on missing, ambiguous, probable, late or conflicted evidence. Same game market product, period, quote, result and settlement for every arm. Selection is highest probability, ties home. Record all eligible and ineligible opportunities and reasons; operating abstentions remain abstentions.
split: New event IDs only, prospectively captured after this protocol commit. Sequential chronological train 60%, validation 20%, final evaluation 20%, fixed by opportunity order before outcomes are inspected; all same-day opportunities in same block; move boundary forward to next day. Training outcomes must have been actually received before fit. No training on validation or evaluation. No tuning using evaluation. Candidates limited to this one and market baseline.
gate: Minimum 200 eligible training, 60 validation, 100 evaluation games; both labels in train and validation; at least 30 games with nonzero availability feature in each split. If unmet report blocked_data, no fit and no effect or performance claim. On validation select candidate only if mean log loss is strictly less than market; otherwise stop and retain market. One final evaluation after selection; no retuning or automatic adoption. Missing operating revision reported separately and excluded from operating intersection only.
metrics: Opportunity counts, eligibility exclusions and coverage, outcome counts, accuracy, equal-unit ROI at saved selected price, logloss and Brier on common settled binary outcomes, settlement-batch maximum drawdown; report market/no-fact/candidate on identical eligible games and operating on exact intersecting selected games. Separate abstentions and unsettled, cancelled, void and any refund; no imputation. No confidence or success claims with insufficient data.
checks: Python: time leakage incl result availability, duplicates by exact original document bytes SHA with within-game matching, future label poisoning, market identity, price timing, settlement rules and adversarial fixtures. Internal digest is not independent authentication; document bytes must exist before hash verification.
limits: Official 2024-25 KBL rules provide 4x10 minute quarters, 5 minute overtime; season-specific rules and product terms must be verified. Game rules do not establish betting settlement. No direct production changes, model promotion, scheduling, wagering, or retrospective timestamp reconstruction.
